question: Can the current complete-attention-15-background DAS runs causally validate the weight-predicted L15H5 Q/K/V reader interfaces?

predictions.pred_a_authorities_and_weight_scope_matc: All hashes match; the scale-aware weight audit is a repaired diagnostic and the original result ranks L15H5 interfaces.
predictions.pred_b_complete_attn15_overwrites_comput: In the shared manual intervention, complete15 replaces every layer-15 head output with a fixed donor-cache tensor immediately before c_proj.
predictions.pred_c_das_fit_and_evaluation_always_ena: The v15 fit core and the queued multi-environment path call the shared intervention with complete15=True for fitted checkpoint and crossfit outcomes.
predictions.pred_d_l15h5_reader_is_not_causally_iden: The layer-15 Q/K/V-to-head-output derivative is zero under the complete overwrite, although upstream changes can still travel through the residual skip into MLP15 and layers 16-17.

decision: If all pass, retain the DAS result as an upstream-projector-plus-attention-15-background circuit and demote L15H5 to a native-reader hypothesis. After a construction-stable projector exists, run a 2x2 upstream-projector by complete-attention-15 factorial without refitting; only an upstream-only live-attention effect licenses L15H5 interface reset/rescue.
